entry_schema.base_sha: 40-character lowercase effective comparison base SHA (the measured merge base)
entry_schema.head_python_content_fingerprint: 64-character lowercase SHA-256 fingerprint of all tracked Python blobs at the measured head; avoids self-reference while invalidating the exception when any measured Python content changes
entry_schema.expires_on: YYYY-MM-DD deliberate approver-controlled debt expiry; unlike floating tool versions, this intentional date makes stale exception debt fail closed

entries.reason: Reviewed #621 tenant admission at the Core benchmark seam: production +107 lines, tests +487. The production half carries the admission refusal before I/O, the X-Tenant-Id transport, the echo-integrity check and the reconciliation/data-quality statuses. The test half is deliberately the larger part and is not shallow bulk: seven review findings on this PR were that declared coverage did not execute, so these lines are what make the consumer-contract lane run what it names -- admitted, unscoped, undecodable-body, Core-refusal, timeout and one-attempt cases, each asserting the outbound call, plus a serialized provider fixture parsed through the adapter's own response model. Bound to the measured head content so any further Python change invalidates it, and expiring so the allowance cannot become the steady state.

Reviewed #624 tenant-scoped policy-evaluation closure: +157 production lines carry admitted tenant authority through API, application, repository, snapshot and PostgreSQL boundaries; scope idempotency without changing historical hashes or receipts; quarantine unattributable rows before hydration; and enforce proposal/portfolio ownership before Copilot source assembly. +696 tests provide discriminating unit, HTTP, migration, restart, contention and real PostgreSQL isolation proof for the complete contract and both review-found security defects. This revision-bound exception does not relax the 200-line steady-state threshold, complexity, coverage, security, typing, contract or assertion gates.

Reviewed Cycle 6 #632/#628/#601/#590 closure: tenant-owned Copilot packets, runs, replay and review now carry admitted authority through API, application, PostgreSQL persistence and migration boundaries; real PostgreSQL isolation, rollback/restart and competing-reviewer proof, strict dependency freshness exception handling, exact per-revision main dispatch/audit, and lane-parity checks add implementation and discriminating evidence rather than shallow bulk. The exact measured allowance does not relax coverage, security, typing, ownership, or durable-write controls.

Reviewed Cycle 6 #628/#601/#590 control parsing and fail-closed classification add three bounded B-ranked functions. Their scope is restricted to dependency-exception matching and main-gate/parity evidence classification; the worst complexity remains 10 and this exact-content exception expires for follow-up simplification.

Reviewed Cycle 6 corrective follow-up for #632/#628/#590: +929 measured Python lines add principal-bound Copilot outbound tenant propagation and model-context receipt separation; pip-audit producer-schema fail-closed handling; executable CI parity semantics; and focused registered HTTP, adapter, dependency and mutation regressions. The parity evidence proves that comments, echoes, independent matrix expansion, Python -c/-m arguments, dry-run Make including MAKEFLAGS, pytest collection/filter modes, option-value paths, and changed-coverage skip receipts cannot masquerade as an executed control. The allowance is bound to this exact measured Python content and merge base, expires deliberately, and does not relax the 200-line steady-state threshold, security, typing, coverage, ownership, PostgreSQL or workflow controls.

Reviewed Cycle 6 #590 executable-evidence correction: +381 measured Python lines replace workflow-text matching with typed job/step condition, inherited environment and effective job-local matrix context; refuse shell-control lists and ambiguous pytest options; require complete changed-coverage inputs; and register real shipped workflows/policy mutations for skip-reason equals form, false job/step conditions including literal-false conjunctions/disjunctions, short-circuit wrappers, MAKEFLAGS n/t/q, cache display, artifact-path contamination, and excluded matrix paths. The bounded parser adds no expensive lane and does not relax security, coverage, PostgreSQL ownership/replay, or the steady-state 200-line threshold.
